@Knockback Games - Sincognito ♥ 4.3K · 💬 169

Sincognito Teaser Trailer Out Now!!

Sincognito is a Social-Deduction, Stealth, Physics based Horror game based on the 7 Deadly Sins.

- Wishlist & Playtest on Steam -

Please like, share, and playtest with your friends!

@nizima ACTION!! - 動画編集に、Live2Dという付加価値を。 ♥ 1.2K · 💬 0

Hey, VTubers and Live2D Riggers! nizima ACTION!! is Live2D's official online video editor with full support for Live2D models. Track your model while recording, and easily create short videos with various templates. Try it now, completely free during beta!

@Enter Pro by Converge AI ♥ 98 · 💬 9

"Enter i18n is live — enable it once and your website speaks every language.
No more JSON files or debugging libraries. Enter detects your stack, installs everything, and gives you a visual editor for translations.
Open the panel, pick your languages, rebuild. "

@TOM HU ♥ 9 · 💬 1

Demo2Product趋于无穷大
Product2Market趋于无穷大
谁解决这两个问题，它就成功定位在无穷大的市场里了

@Leaf Yeah! ♥ 5 · 💬 1

而且基本都是前端demo，给外行看，就觉得你很厉害，很懂AI。其实跟做个PPT没啥区别，只是改成了一个可交互的网页。
还有的说 Vibe Coding 让产品和研发沟通更顺畅，但这对于能想清楚需求的人是吧？不然的话，花在给 AI 指令的时间，都不如自己直接上手倒腾画布了。
